   193	
   194	/* This debugging function displays the current set of frames and their
   195	contents. It is not called automatically from anywhere, the intention being
   196	that calls can be inserted where necessary when debugging frame-related
   197	problems.
   198	
   199	Arguments:
   200	  f           the file to write to
   201	  F           the current top frame
   202	  P           a previous frame of interest
   203	  frame_size  the frame size
   204	  mb          points to the match block
   205	  s           identification text
   206	
   207	Returns:    nothing
   208	*/
   209	
   210	static void
   211	display_frames(FILE *f, heapframe *F, heapframe *P, PCRE2_SIZE frame_size,
   212	  match_block *mb, const char *s, ...)
   213	{
   214	uint32_t i;
   215	heapframe *Q;
   216	va_list ap;
   217	va_start(ap, s);
   218	
   219	fprintf(f, "FRAMES ");
   220	vfprintf(f, s, ap);
   221	va_end(ap);
   222	
   223	if (P != NULL) fprintf(f, " P=%lu",
   224	  ((char *)P - (char *)(mb->match_frames))/frame_size);
   225	fprintf(f, "\n");
   226	
   227	for (i = 0, Q = mb->match_frames;
   228	     Q <= F;
   229	     i++, Q = (heapframe *)((char *)Q + frame_size))
   230	  {
   231	  fprintf(f, "Frame %d type=%x subj=%lu code=%d back=%lu id=%d",
   232	    i, Q->group_frame_type, Q->eptr - mb->start_subject, *(Q->ecode),
   233	    Q->back_frame, Q->return_id);
   234	
   235	  if (Q->last_group_offset == PCRE2_UNSET)
   236	    fprintf(f, " lgoffset=unset\n");
   237	  else
   238	    fprintf(f, " lgoffset=%lu\n",  Q->last_group_offset/frame_size);
   239	  }

   246	/*************************************************
   247	*                Process a callout               *
   248	*************************************************/
   249	
   250	/* This function is called for all callouts, whether "standalone" or at the
   251	start of a conditional group. Feptr will be pointing to either OP_CALLOUT or
   252	OP_CALLOUT_STR.
   253	
   254	Arguments:
   255	  F          points to the current backtracking frame
   256	  mb         points to the match block
   257	  lengthptr  where to return the length of the callout item
   258	
   259	Returns:     the return from the callout
   260	             or 0 if no callout function exists
   261	*/
   262	
   263	static int
   264	do_callout(heapframe *F, match_block *mb, PCRE2_SIZE *lengthptr)
   265	{
   266	PCRE2_SIZE save0, save1;
   267	pcre2_callout_block cb;
   268	int rc;
   269	
   270	*lengthptr = (*Fecode == OP_CALLOUT)?
   271	  PRIV(OP_lengths)[OP_CALLOUT] : GET(Fecode, 1 + 2*LINK_SIZE);
   272	
   273	if (mb->callout == NULL) return 0;   /* No callout function provided */
   274	cb.version          = 1;
   275	cb.capture_top      = (uint32_t)Foffset_top/2 + 1;
   276	cb.capture_last     = Fcapture_last;
   277	cb.offset_vector    = Fovector - 2;
   278	cb.mark             = mb->nomatch_mark;
   279	cb.subject          = mb->start_subject;
   280	cb.subject_length   = (PCRE2_SIZE)(mb->end_subject - mb->start_subject);
   281	cb.start_match      = (PCRE2_SIZE)(Fstart_match - mb->start_subject);
   282	cb.current_position = (PCRE2_SIZE)(Feptr - mb->start_subject);
   283	cb.pattern_position = GET(Fecode, 1);
   284	cb.next_item_length = GET(Fecode, 1 + LINK_SIZE);
   285	
   286	if (*Fecode == OP_CALLOUT)  /* Numerical callout */
   287	  {
   288	  cb.callout_number = Fecode[1 + 2*LINK_SIZE];
   289	  cb.callout_string_offset = 0;
   290	  cb.callout_string = NULL;
   291	  cb.callout_string_length = 0;
   292	  }
   293	else  /* String callout */
   294	  {
   295	  cb.callout_number = 0;
   296	  cb.callout_string_offset = GET(Fecode, 1 + 3*LINK_SIZE);
   297	  cb.callout_string = Fecode + (1 + 4*LINK_SIZE) + 1;
   298	  cb.callout_string_length =
   299	    *lengthptr - (1 + 4*LINK_SIZE) - 2;
   300	  }
   301	
   302	/* The original matching code (pre 10.30) worked directly with the ovector
   303	passed by the user, and this was passed to callouts. Now that the working
   304	ovector is in the backtracking frame, it no longer needs to reserve space for
   305	the overall match offsets (which would waste space in the frame). For backward
   306	compatibility, however, we pass capture_top and offset_vector to the callout as
   307	if for the extended ovector, and we ensure that the first two slots are unset
   308	by preserving and restoring their current contents. */
   309	
   310	save0 = Fovector[-2];
   311	save1 = Fovector[-1];
   312	Fovector[-2] = Fovector[-1] = PCRE2_UNSET;
   313	rc = mb->callout(&cb, mb->callout_data);
   314	Fovector[-2] = save0;
   315	Fovector[-1] = save1;
   316	return rc;
   317	}

   321	/*************************************************
   322	*          Match a back-reference                *
   323	*************************************************/
   324	
   325	/* This function is called only when it is known that the offset lies within
   326	the offsets that have so far been used in the match. Note that in caseless
   327	UTF-8 mode, the number of subject bytes matched may be different to the number
   328	of reference bytes. (In theory this could also happen in UTF-16 mode, but it
   329	seems unlikely.)
   330	
   331	Arguments:
   332	  offset      index into the offset vector
   333	  caseless    TRUE if caseless
   334	  F           the current backtracking frame pointer
   335	  mb          points to match block
   336	  lengthptr   pointer for returning the length matched
   337	
   338	Returns:      = 0 sucessful match; number of code units matched is set
   339	              < 0 no match
   340	              > 0 partial match
   341	*/
   342	
   343	static int
   344	match_ref(PCRE2_SIZE offset, BOOL caseless, heapframe *F, match_block *mb,
   345	  PCRE2_SIZE *lengthptr)
   346	{
   347	PCRE2_SPTR p;
   348	PCRE2_SIZE length;
   349	PCRE2_SPTR eptr;
   350	PCRE2_SPTR eptr_start;
   351	
   352	/* Deal with an unset group. The default is no match, but there is an option to
   353	match an empty string. */
   354	
   355	if (offset >= Foffset_top || Fovector[offset] == PCRE2_UNSET)
   356	  {
   357	  if ((mb->poptions & PCRE2_MATCH_UNSET_BACKREF) != 0)
   358	    {
   359	    *lengthptr = 0;
   360	    return 0;      /* Match */
   361	    }
   362	  else return -1;  /* No match */
   363	  }
   364	
   365	/* Separate the caseless and UTF cases for speed. */
   366	
   367	eptr = eptr_start = Feptr;
   368	p = mb->start_subject + Fovector[offset];
   369	length = Fovector[offset+1] - Fovector[offset];
   370	
   371	if (caseless)
   372	  {
   373	#if defined SUPPORT_UNICODE
   374	  if ((mb->poptions & PCRE2_UTF) != 0)
   375	    {
   376	    /* Match characters up to the end of the reference. NOTE: the number of
   377	    code units matched may differ, because in UTF-8 there are some characters
   378	    whose upper and lower case codes have different numbers of bytes. For
   379	    example, U+023A (2 bytes in UTF-8) is the upper case version of U+2C65 (3
   380	    bytes in UTF-8); a sequence of 3 of the former uses 6 bytes, as does a
   381	    sequence of two of the latter. It is important, therefore, to check the
   382	    length along the reference, not along the subject (earlier code did this
   383	    wrong). */
   384	
   385	    PCRE2_SPTR endptr = p + length;
   386	    while (p < endptr)
   387	      {
   388	      uint32_t c, d;
   389	      const ucd_record *ur;
   390	      if (eptr >= mb->end_subject) return 1;   /* Partial match */
   391	      GETCHARINC(c, eptr);
   392	      GETCHARINC(d, p);
   393	      ur = GET_UCD(d);
   394	      if (c != d && c != (uint32_t)((int)d + ur->other_case))
   395	        {
   396	        const uint32_t *pp = PRIV(ucd_caseless_sets) + ur->caseset;
   397	        for (;;)
   398	          {
   399	          if (c < *pp) return -1;  /* No match */
   400	          if (c == *pp++) break;
   401	          }
   402	        }
   403	      }
   404	    }
   405	  else
   406	#endif
   407	
   408	    /* Not in UTF mode */
   409	
   410	    {
   411	    for (; length > 0; length--)
   412	      {
   413	      uint32_t cc, cp;
   414	      if (eptr >= mb->end_subject) return 1;   /* Partial match */
   415	      cc = UCHAR21TEST(eptr);
   416	      cp = UCHAR21TEST(p);
   417	      if (TABLE_GET(cp, mb->lcc, cp) != TABLE_GET(cc, mb->lcc, cc))
   418	        return -1;  /* No match */
   419	      p++;
   420	      eptr++;
   421	      }
   422	    }
   423	  }
   424	
   425	/* In the caseful case, we can just compare the code units, whether or not we
   426	are in UTF mode. When partial matching, we have to do this unit-by-unit. */
   427	
   428	else
   429	  {
   430	  if (mb->partial != 0)
   431	    {
   432	    for (; length > 0; length--)
   433	      {
   434	      if (eptr >= mb->end_subject) return 1;   /* Partial match */
   435	      if (UCHAR21INCTEST(p) != UCHAR21INCTEST(eptr)) return -1;  /* No match */
   436	      }
   437	    }
   438	
   439	  /* Not partial matching */
   440	
   441	  else
   442	    {
   443	    if ((PCRE2_SIZE)(mb->end_subject - eptr) < length) return 1; /* Partial */
   444	    if (memcmp(p, eptr, CU2BYTES(length)) != 0) return -1;  /* No match */
   445	    eptr += length;
   446	    }
   447	  }
   448	
   449	*lengthptr = eptr - eptr_start;
   450	return 0;  /* Match */
   451	}
